article.en: My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland.

article.en: Last year, we were travelling across the Channel and Jane put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into a bottle.

article.en: Both girls write to each other regularly now.

article.en: However, they have decided to use the post office.
